additional_sources.title: UK ETS Public Reports: Compliance Report - emissions and surrenders
additional_sources.guard: Official UK ETS Registry page confirms a current 215.7 kB Compliance Report covering emissions and allowances surrendered for 2021-2025 scheme years. This is a verified-emissions authority surface; no installation row is promoted until the exact workbook row is directly readable.

additional_sources.title: DESNZ: HSE emissions and targets 2021 to 2025
additional_sources.guard: Official transparency page states the attached spreadsheet contains each HSE installation, regulator, annual target and actual emissions for every year through 2025. Binary row access is unavailable in the current client, so zero numeric installation rows are inferred.

additional_sources.title: UK ETS HSE: how to comply
additional_sources.guard: Current official guidance defines reportable emissions monitoring from 1 January to 31 December, annual emissions reports and verification/declaration rules. Method provenance only; thresholds or targets are not observed emissions.

additional_sources.title: Environment Agency Chief Regulator report 2024-25 supporting evidence
additional_sources.guard: Official EA page publishes exact 2024 greenhouse-gas totals from permitted sites by sector and overall. These are England permitted-site sector aggregates in million tonnes CO2e, not installation or parcel measurements.

additional_sources.title: Environment Agency Public Register: Drax Power Station EPR/VP3530LS
additional_sources.guard: Official public register identifies Drax Power Limited, Drax Power Station, effective permit EPR/VP3530LS, YO8 8PH and grid reference SE6641026480. This strengthens onshore England installation identity/spatial binding only; no emissions quantity is implied.

guard_contract.MEASUREMENT_CANDIDATE: Exact installation, scheme year, gas/CO2e, quantity, unit and verified/reportable provenance are required before numeric promotion. Dataset authority alone is not a row.
guard_contract.MEASUREMENT_CONTEXT: Sector or national aggregates remain context and cannot be attributed to installations or parcels.
guard_contract.BINDING_CANDIDATE: Permit, address and grid reference strengthen installation identity/spatial binding only; no measured emissions are implied.
guard_contract.SOURCE_UPGRADE: Monitoring, reporting, threshold or verification guidance supplies methodology only; targets and eligibility thresholds are not observed emissions.

web_research_basis: Fresh official internet research on 2026-07-27. Current UK ETS Registry compliance and HSE transparency surfaces expose authoritative verified/actual emissions datasets but row-level spreadsheets are not directly readable in the current client. EA 2024 sector totals are retained only as aggregate context. Drax public-register permit/address/grid data is retained only as onshore binding. No repeated binary retries, OCR, graph inference or fabricated installation values.
